text: This solution, Building Safety and Resilience in the Pacific Phase II (BSRP II) addresses natural catastrophe in Papua New Guinea between Papua New Guinea National Disaster Management Office (NDMO), The Pacific Community (SPC), and European Union (EU). The program was implemented in 2022 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and accessibility.
